item.title: What was agreed, for how long — and what it means for Lebanon: breaking down the Iran ceasefire
item.description: Trump announced overnight a temporary deal with Tehran, and after hours of sirens across Israel, Iran’s supreme leader ordered a halt to attacks; US-Iran talks are set for Friday in Pakistan as the IDF continues operations against Hezbollah

item.title: 'Separate skirmish': Trump says Lebanon not included in Iran ceasefire deal
item.description: Trump says Hezbollah front separate from Iran truce, as Tehran warns it may quit agreement if Israeli strikes in Lebanon continue; Iranian media reports oil tanker traffic through Strait of Hormuz suspended

item.title: Trump says suspended bombing Iran for 2 weeks as Tehran agrees to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: President says he agreed to pause US strikes, describing move as part of possible 'double-sided ceasefire' as Washington and Tehran weigh proposed framework for broader agreement; Israel joins truce, denies Lebanon included

item.title: Iran says ‘gloves are off’ as IRGC threatens escalation beyond region ahead of Trump deadline
item.description: Revolutionary Guards threaten strikes on US and allies if red lines crossed; Trump warns of massive attack within hours; US hit Kharg Island, Israel targets rail and military sites; oil prices surge

item.title: Strikes against Hezbollah could push Iran to resume missile fire on Israel, officials say
item.description: Ceasefire creates a fragile pause, with US forces reinforcing the region, the IDF maintaining high readiness and continuing strikes in Lebanon, and uncertainty over whether Washington would back further escalation if fighting expands

item.title: Iran, Hezbollah launch missiles at Israel as second Passover eve begins; IDF warns of widening escalation
item.description: Ballistic missiles target central and northern Israel as holiday begins; no injuries reported; IDF warns vessels off Lebanon coast to move north amid Hezbollah activity; military says campaign against Iran nearing 'strategic crossroads'

item.title: Trump warns Iran: 'A whole civilization will die tonight'
item.description: US and Israel hit Iran’s Kharg oil hub and key infrastructure, including bridges and missile sites; Iran warned it could target regional energy assets, while reports described casualties, power outages and expanding attacks across multiple cities

item.title: Iran changes course, core issues remain — opposition leader Lapid: 'An unprecedented disaster'
item.description: After the ceasefire announcement, Lapid said Netanyahu 'failed to meet any goal,' as critics in Israel and abroad assailed the deal; Iran reversed course within hours and its plan leaves uranium in place, the regime intact and expands control over the Strait of Hormuz

item.title: Iran fires repeatedly at Israel after Trump extends ultimatum to Tehran
item.description: Non-stop sirens blare across central, southern and northern parts of Israel after US president announced 2-week suspension of bombing tied to Iran reopening Strait of Hormuz; 3 teens lightly hurt in Tel Sheva

item.title: How Trump decided to strike Iran as aides dismissed Netanyahu’s regime change plan as ‘bullshit’
item.description: NYT report reveals internal White House debates before war; Trump aligned with Netanyahu on strikes but rejected regime change scenarios, which US officials called 'farcical' and 'bullshit,' before approving operation hours before deadline
